item.title: Production Runner 0.1.1
item.description:
• What's New in 0.1.1: Production Runner 0.1.1 updates the public beta: Home, Script (Write and Breakdown, with Cast ID and Reports), Shots, the Scheduler, Contacts, Locations and Tasks, all working on your own computer. Make the Sample Production again to see it all.
  • Script: Writing and tagging your script now happen in one module, Script: write or import in Write, then tag cast, props and other elements in Breakdown.
  • The Scheduler: Plan your shoot: drag scenes onto shooting days on the Board, see which days each actor works in Cast Days, make call sheets and write Daily Reports.
  • Printing on the Mac: File > Print now opens the print dialog on a Mac. In 0.1.0 it could not print.
  • Updates inside the app on a Mac: When a new version is ready, choose Install Update: Production Runner installs it and reopens on the new version. Your productions are kept.
  • Scheduler fixes: Every shooting day now ends on its END OF DAY line, the last one too. Right-click a day's END OF DAY line to delete that day. New Call Sheet asks which day the sheet is for.
  • Shots: Return saves the shot you are typing in; it no longer makes a new shot (New Shot, Shift-Command-N, does). Drag shots into a new order and their letters follow.
  • Location permits on Home: Home says Permit needed (not Permit Not Approved) and counts only permits that are Pending, Needs Scout or Denied. Approving a location no longer adds a pending permit.
